# MageLift

> Open-source CLI and ACC/Upsun-shaped YAML for Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce in your own AWS or GCP account. MageLift does not host stores; you pay AWS or GCP directly.

MageLift (Apache-2.0) deploys Magento with familiar YAML and day-2 CLI verbs. Certified production targets today: **AWS ECS Fargate** and **GCP GKE Autopilot**. Experimental: AWS EKS, OVH MKS, Scaleway Kapsule.

- Home: https://magelift.dev/
- Docs: https://magelift.dev/docs/

## Who it is for

Agency tech leads (roughly 3-20 Magento shops) and SME Magento owners who want Magento in their cloud without starting from a blank Terraform/Pulumi stack, and without renting a Magento PaaS.

## Definition

MageLift is an open-source Magento deployment CLI that uses ACC/Upsun-shaped YAML to run Magento in your AWS or GCP account.
